content:
maria: Starting final publish for python v2.4.0 and ts v1.9.0. Quiet window 21:00-22:00 PT. Please watch.

deploy-bot: publish job queued by @maria. Job id: jb_3921. Staged cohorts: 5% -> 25% -> 100%.

dan: I'll monitor the py wheels signing step. cc @sre-jess for infra watch.

sre-jess: watching GPU-hosting infra. No incidents in the last hour.

chris-docs: note to docs: need to add deprecation note for the old sync client in the changelog. Small snippet ready.

maria: rollout plan: push staged 5% now; wait 10m -> promote to 25% if no errors -> full. If any 5xx or upload fails, rollback to previous dist tag.

dan: For rollback, what's the command? I can run:
```
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.8.9 stable
python -m pip index versions redwood-sdk # verify
```

maria: rollback playbook: 1) abort job on deploy UI 2) retag stable -> previous 3) revert canary clients via quick patch. Dan, you'll trigger.

deploy-bot: jb_3921: stage 5% promoted -> 25% at 1748632200. No errors reported by canary tests.

maria: running smoke: sample calls to /v1/generate, embedding checks, and client init with KMS key. Results: ok so far.

dan: found one flaky test in TS integration (streaming chunk order). I'll patch a retry in client and prepare patch release if needed.

chris-docs: deprecation blurb for sync client drafted: "The legacy sync client will be removed in 3 months. Migrate to async APIs or new unified client. See migration guide: https://redwood.dev/migrate-sync"

sre-jess: infra spike detected at 1748632600 in north-virginia region, small ingress rise but below threshold. No action.

maria: promote to 100% in 10m if no regressions. If dan's TS flaky test escalates, hold at 25% and issue patch.

dan: ETA for patch if needed ~45m. Will create hotfix branch and ping here.

deploy-bot: jb_3921: promoted to 100% at 1748633300. Publish success: python v2.4.0, ts v1.9.0. Release notes URL: https://redwood.dev/releases/2.4.0

maria: great. docs to publish deprecation notice aligned with release. chris-docs, can you post the blurb in release notes and docs site? :thumbsup:

chris-docs: will do in a couple minutes, adding migration guide link.

sre-jess: closing watch window in 30m unless new alerts.

dan: re: monitoring — I'll add a short smoke that verifies streaming ordering for ts clients and add to QA canaries tomorrow.

maria: thanks all. If anyone sees post-release anomalies tag #prod-issues and ping @oncall.

deploy-bot: Note: automated tag `publish:completed` added to release. jb_3921 closed.

maria: thread resolved. :party_parrot:
